Privacy Policy — Aura Archana AI Last Updated: August 11, 2026 1. Introduction Welcome to Aura Archana AI ("we", "our", or "the App"). By using Aura Archana AI, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. 2. Information We May Collect Depending on the features you use, Aura Archana AI may process the following information. Personal information When you use Numerology or other personalized features, you may provide: Name Date of birth Birth time, if you use astrology/Kundali features Birthplace, if you use astrology/Kundali features Information that you voluntarily enter into questions or readings We only request information that is relevant to the feature you choose to use. Reading information The App may process: Tarot cards selected during a reading Questions submitted for a reading Numerology results AI-generated readings Reading history, if you choose to save it Device and technical information Depending on the services and SDKs used by the App, technical information may be processed, such as: Device type Android version App version IP address Advertising ID Approximate device/network information Crash and diagnostic information 3. How We Use Information We may use information to: Provide Tarot readings Calculate Numerology results Generate personalized AI insights Provide Rashi/Kundali features, if available Provide Kundali compatibility features, if available Save and display your reading history Improve application functionality Diagnose crashes and technical problems Prevent abuse and misuse Display advertisements Process premium subscriptions Respond to support requests We do not use your information to make guaranteed predictions about your future. 4. AI-Powered Features Aura Archana AI uses third-party AI services to generate personalized interpretations and guidance. Information required to generate an AI response may be transmitted to our AI service provider. For example, when you request a personalized Numerology or Tarot reading, relevant information such as calculated numerology values, selected Tarot cards, and the question you voluntarily provide may be processed to generate the response. We aim to send only information reasonably necessary to provide the requested AI feature. AI-generated content is provided for entertainment and self-reflection and should not be considered guaranteed predictions or professional advice. 5.
